name: Day 13 — 顏色與洗衣 Colors & Laundry Day

readings.title: 我的衣服 What I Wear

qs.q: What colors does he wear to work?
Why is the black jacket his favorite?
ch: It looks good no matter what

qs.q: What does Xiaomei call his wardrobe?

gram.t: 顏色 + 的 — colors as nouns
gram.d: Color + 色 + 的 turns a color into 'a ___ one': 我要藍色的 I'll take the blue one, 黑色的最好看 the black one looks best. Point at anything in a shop and 的 does the rest.

qs.q: What does he separate before washing?
What does he do during the 40-minute cycle?
Why does drying take a whole day?

gram.t: 把 A 跟 B 分開
gram.d: 把 + things + 分開 = separate them: 把白色的跟深色的分開 separate whites from darks, 把工作跟生活分開 separate work from life. The sorting verb for laundry and boundaries alike.

readings.title: 送洗的教訓 The Dry-Cleaning Lesson

qs.q: What happened to the sweater?
What did the red shirt do?
ch: Faded and dyed the whites pink

qs.q: What's his new policy?
ch: Send good clothes out for cleaning

gram.d: 越 X 越 Y = the more X, the more Y: 越洗越小 the more I washed it, the smaller it got; 越來越好 better and better. Trajectories, good and catastrophic, in four characters.

readings.title: 合作架構草案 Drafting the Framework

qs.q: How were the HSR tickets booked?
What three parts make up the framework draft?
ch: Annual procurement, maintenance contract, joint training

qs.q: What's the proposed signing-day agenda?
ch: Sign in the morning, discuss the future in the afternoon

gram.d: 分成三個部分 = divided into three parts. 分成 organizes anything: 分成兩組 split into two groups, 分成四期 four installments. The proposal-writer's skeleton key.

readings.title: 機能布料王國 The Functional-Fabric Kingdom

qs.q: What secret does the passage reveal about global sports brands?

qs.q: How did Taiwan's textile industry transform?
ch: From cheap garments to high-tech functional fabrics

qs.q: What is the industry's next step?

gram.d: 占有關鍵地位 = holds a key position. 占 (occupy) + 地位 (standing) is how news prose ranks players: 在供應鏈中占有重要地位 — the sentence pattern behind every 'critical role' headline.

qs.q: Why bring a red tie?

dict.en: Take the clothes to the balcony to dry.

qs.q: What's the fix for still-damp clothes?

dict.en: Air-drying is safer.

pass.zh: 您好，您送洗的三件衣服好了：西裝外套跟襯衫都燙好了，毛衣我們用手洗，沒有烘乾，比較不會縮水。一共兩百八，明天以前來拿都可以。

qs.q: How many items were cleaned?
How was the sweater treated?
What's the total?

dict.zh: 高鐵票用早鳥優惠訂好了。
dict.py: Gāotiě piào yòng zǎoniǎo yōuhuì dìng hǎo le.
dict.en: The HSR tickets are booked with the early-bird discount.

dict.zh: 主管請我準備合作架構的提案。
dict.py: Zhǔguǎn qǐng wǒ zhǔnbèi hézuò jiàgòu de tí'àn.
dict.en: The boss asked me to prepare the cooperation-framework proposal.

dict.py: Cǎo'àn fēn chéng sān ge bùfèn.

qs.q: What happens at 10 a.m. on the 10th?
When is the framework discussion?
When is the draft due to the boss?

dict.zh: 台灣的機能布料世界有名。
dict.py: Táiwān de jīnéng bùliào shìjiè yǒumíng.
dict.en: Taiwan's functional fabrics are world-famous.

dict.zh: 紡織產業早已轉型成功。
dict.py: Fǎngzhī chǎnyè zǎo yǐ zhuǎnxíng chénggōng.
dict.en: The textile industry transformed long ago.

dict.zh: 台灣在供應鏈中占有關鍵地位。
dict.py: Táiwān zài gōngyìngliàn zhōng zhànyǒu guānjiàn dìwèi.
dict.en: Taiwan holds a key position in the supply chain.

dict.py: Yǒngxù cáiliào shì guójì dìngdān de xīn biāozhǔn.
dict.en: Sustainable materials are the new standard for international orders.

pass.zh: 產業新聞：全球運動品牌的衣服，很多用的是台灣布料。紡織業者表示，從吸濕排汗到防水透氣，台灣的機能布料在全球供應鏈占有關鍵地位。專家指出，下一波是永續：用回收寶特瓶做的布料，已成為國際大廠下單的基本要求。

qs.q: What is Taiwan's textile strength today?
What has become a basic requirement from international brands?
What examples of fabric functions are given?

scenarios.intro: Signing day needs one more shirt. Name your colors, use the 的-trick, and resist the pink.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨！想找什麼樣的襯衫？
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín! Xiǎng zhǎo shénme yàng de chènshān?
them.en: Welcome! What kind of shirt are you looking for?

turns.task: You want a white one — for work.

ans.zh: 我要白色的，上班穿的。
ans.py: Wǒ yào báisè de, shàngbān chuān de.
ans.en: A white one — for work.

them.zh: 白色的在這邊。這件粉紅色的也很好看喔！
them.py: Báisè de zài zhèbiān. Zhè jiàn fěnhóngsè de yě hěn hǎokàn o!
them.en: Whites are over here. This pink one is lovely too!

turns.task: Politely pass on pink — you'll stick with white, plus maybe a blue one.

ans.zh: 粉紅色先不用，我要白色的，可能再加一件藍色的。
ans.py: Fěnhóngsè xiān búyòng, wǒ yào báisè de, kěnéng zài jiā yí jiàn lánsè de.
ans.en: Pass on pink for now — white, and maybe a blue one too.

them.zh: 好眼光！這兩件都不容易皺。
them.py: Hǎo yǎnguāng! Zhè liǎng jiàn dōu bù róngyì zhòu.
them.en: Good eye! Neither of these wrinkles easily.

turns.task: Ask: can they go in the washing machine, or do they need special care?

ans.zh: 請問可以用洗衣機洗嗎？還是要特別照顧？
ans.py: Qǐngwèn kěyǐ yòng xǐyījī xǐ ma? Háishì yào tèbié zhàogù?
ans.en: Can these go in the washing machine, or do they need special care?

them.zh: 可以機洗，但是不要烘乾，會縮水。
them.py: Kěyǐ jī xǐ, dànshì búyào hōnggān, huì suōshuǐ.
them.en: Machine-washable — but no machine-drying, they'll shrink.

turns.task: Noted — you learned the shrinking lesson the hard way; take both shirts.

ans.zh: 了解，縮水的教訓我學過了！兩件都要。
ans.py: Liǎojiě, suōshuǐ de jiàoxùn wǒ xué guò le! Liǎng jiàn dōu yào.
ans.en: Understood — I've learned the shrinking lesson! I'll take both.

them.zh: 一共一千六。祝你穿得帥帥的！
them.py: Yígòng yìqiān liù. Zhù nǐ chuān de shuàishuài de!
them.en: 1,600 total. Wear them well!

turns.task: Thank them — these are for a big day next month!

ans.zh: 謝謝！這是為了下個月的大日子準備的！
ans.py: Xièxie! Zhè shì wèile xià ge yuè de dà rìzi zhǔnbèi de!
ans.en: Thanks — these are for next month's big day!

scenarios.intro: Your whites came out pink. Confess the crime, learn the sorting gospel, and accept the mockery with grace.

them.zh: 你今天的襯衫……怎麼是粉紅色的？
them.py: Nǐ jīntiān de chènshān...... zěnme shì fěnhóngsè de?
them.en: Your shirt today… why is it pink?

turns.task: Confess: you washed a red shirt with the white ones.

ans.zh: 我把紅色的跟白色的一起洗了……
ans.py: Wǒ bǎ hóngsè de gēn báisè de yìqǐ xǐ le......
ans.en: I washed a red one with the whites…

them.zh: 哈哈哈！第一課：深色跟淺色要分開洗！
them.py: Hāhāhā! Dì yī kè: shēnsè gēn qiǎnsè yào fēnkāi xǐ!
them.en: Hahaha! Lesson one: darks and lights wash SEPARATELY!

turns.task: Ask what else you should know — hot water or cold?

ans.zh: 還有什麼要注意的？要用熱水還是冷水？
ans.py: Hái yǒu shénme yào zhùyì de? Yào yòng rè shuǐ háishì lěng shuǐ?
ans.en: What else should I know — hot water or cold?

them.zh: 冷水最安全！熱水會讓衣服縮水、褪色。
them.py: Lěng shuǐ zuì ānquán! Rè shuǐ huì ràng yīfú suōshuǐ, tùnsè.
them.en: Cold is safest! Hot water shrinks and fades things.

turns.task: That explains the sweater… ask about drying — machine-dry or hang-dry?

ans.zh: 難怪我的毛衣變小了……那要烘乾還是用曬的？
ans.py: Nánguài wǒ de máoyī biàn xiǎo le...... nà yào hōnggān háishì yòng shài de?
ans.en: THAT explains my sweater… and drying — machine or hang-dry?

them.zh: 台灣人多半用曬的，省電又不傷衣服。
them.py: Táiwān rén duōbàn yòng shài de, shěng diàn yòu bù shāng yīfú.
them.en: Most Taiwanese hang-dry — saves power and spares the clothes.

turns.task: Got it: separate, cold water, hang-dry. Recite the three rules back!

ans.zh: 我記住了：分開洗、用冷水、用曬的！
ans.py: Wǒ jìzhù le: fēnkāi xǐ, yòng lěng shuǐ, yòng shài de!
ans.en: Memorized: separate, cold water, hang-dry!

them.zh: 及格！不過粉紅色其實滿適合你的，哈哈！
them.py: Jígé! Búguò fěnhóngsè qíshí mǎn shìhé nǐ de, hāhā!
them.en: You pass! Though honestly — pink kind of suits you, haha!

turns.task: Take the joke: fine, this shirt is now a 'limited edition'.

ans.zh: 好啦，這件現在是「限量版」！
ans.py: Hǎo la, zhè jiàn xiànzài shì 'xiànliàng bǎn'!
ans.en: Fine — this shirt is now a 'limited edition'!

scenarios.who: 洗衣店老闆娘 Laundry Shop Owner
scenarios.intro: The suit that will witness a signature deserves professional hands. Specify the items, the care, the deadline — and hold the line on machine-drying.

them.zh: 你好！今天要洗什麼？
them.py: Nǐ hǎo! Jīntiān yào xǐ shénme?
them.en: Hello! What are we cleaning today?

turns.task: Send three items: a suit jacket and two shirts — the suit is for an important occasion.

ans.zh: 你好，送洗一件西裝外套跟兩件襯衫。西裝是重要場合要穿的。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, sòngxǐ yí jiàn xīzhuāng wàitào gēn liǎng jiàn chènshān. Xīzhuāng shì zhòngyào chǎnghé yào chuān de.
ans.en: Hi — a suit jacket and two shirts. The suit's for an important occasion.

them.zh: 沒問題。襯衫要上漿嗎？挺一點比較好看。
them.py: Méi wèntí. Chènshān yào shàngjiāng ma? Tǐng yìdiǎn bǐjiào hǎokàn.
them.en: Sure. Starch on the shirts? A little stiffness looks sharper.

turns.task: Light starch, please — and everything ironed.

ans.zh: 上一點點漿就好，全部都要燙。
ans.py: Shàng yìdiǎndiǎn jiāng jiù hǎo, quánbù dōu yào tàng.
ans.en: Just a light starch — and iron everything, please.

them.zh: 好。這件西裝的布料很好，要烘乾嗎？
them.py: Hǎo. Zhè jiàn xīzhuāng de bùliào hěn hǎo, yào hōnggān ma?
them.en: Got it. This suit's fabric is lovely — machine-dry it?

turns.task: No machine-drying — air-dry naturally; you're worried about shrinking and fading.

ans.zh: 不要烘乾，自然乾就好。我怕縮水跟褪色。
ans.py: Búyào hōnggān, zìrán gān jiù hǎo. Wǒ pà suōshuǐ gēn tùnsè.
ans.en: No machine-drying — air-dry. I'm worried about shrinking and fading.

them.zh: 內行喔！什麼時候要拿？
them.py: Nèiháng o! Shénme shíhòu yào ná?
them.en: You know your stuff! When do you need them?

turns.task: By next Friday at the latest — and ask the total.

ans.zh: 最晚下星期五以前。請問一共多少錢？
ans.py: Zuìwǎn xià xīngqí wǔ yǐqián. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
ans.en: By next Friday at the latest. How much altogether?

them.zh: 兩百八。放心，交給我，保證跟新的一樣！
them.py: Liǎngbǎi bā. Fàngxīn, jiāo gěi wǒ, bǎozhèng gēn xīn de yíyàng!
them.en: 280. Relax — leave it to me, good as new, guaranteed!

turns.task: Perfect — this suit has to witness a contract signing next month!

ans.zh: 太好了！這件西裝下個月要見證簽約的！
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Zhè jiàn xīzhuāng xià ge yuè yào jiànzhèng qiānyuē de!
ans.en: Perfect — this suit witnesses a contract signing next month!

scenarios.intro: Your framework draft hits the boss's desk. Walk the three parts, defend the structure, absorb one sharp edit, and take the Friday deadline.

them.zh: Eric，長期合作的草案寫得怎麼樣了？
them.py: Eric, chángqí hézuò de cǎo'àn xiě de zěnmeyàng le?
them.en: Eric, how's the long-term cooperation draft coming?

turns.task: Report the structure: divided into three parts — annual procurement plan, maintenance contract, joint training.

ans.zh: 草案分成三個部分：每年的採購計畫、維修合約，還有共同訓練。
ans.py: Cǎo'àn fēn chéng sān ge bùfèn: měi nián de cǎigòu jìhuà, wéixiū héyuē, háiyǒu gòngtóng xùnliàn.
ans.en: It's divided into three parts: annual procurement plan, maintenance contract, and joint training.

turns.keys: 三個部分採購維修訓練

them.zh: 為什麼把共同訓練放進去？
them.py: Wèishénme bǎ gòngtóng xùnliàn fàng jìnqù?
them.en: Why include joint training?

turns.task: Defend it: training their operators deepens reliance on your system — trained customers rarely switch suppliers.

ans.zh: 因為幫他們訓練操作人員，會讓他們更依賴我們的系統——受過訓練的客戶很少換供應商。
ans.py: Yīnwèi bāng tāmen xùnliàn cāozuò rényuán, huì ràng tāmen gèng yīlài wǒmen de xìtǒng — shòu guò xùnliàn de kèhù hěnshǎo huàn gōngyìngshāng.
ans.en: Training their operators deepens reliance on our system — trained customers rarely switch suppliers.

them.zh: 想得遠，很好。不過議程有個問題：簽約當天就談三個部分，會不會太趕？
them.py: Xiǎng de yuǎn, hěn hǎo. Búguò yìchéng yǒu ge wèntí: qiānyuē dàngtiān jiù tán sān ge bùfèn, huì bú huì tài gǎn?
them.en: Long-range thinking, good. But the agenda — all three parts on signing day, isn't that rushed?

turns.task: Take the edit: present the framework that afternoon but agree on principles only — details go to a second meeting.

ans.zh: 有道理。那當天下午先提出架構，只談原則，細節另外約第二次會議。
ans.py: Yǒu dàolǐ. Nà dàngtiān xiàwǔ xiān tíchū jiàgòu, zhǐ tán yuánzé, xìjié lìngwài yuē dì èr cì huìyì.
ans.en: Fair point — that afternoon we present the framework and agree on principles only; details go to a second meeting.

them.zh: 這樣安排成熟多了。草案什麼時候給我？
them.py: Zhèyàng ānpái chéngshú duō le. Cǎo'àn shénme shíhòu gěi wǒ?
them.en: Much more mature. When do I get the draft?

turns.task: Commit: revised draft by Friday morning, with the agenda attached.

ans.zh: 星期五早上以前，修改好的草案跟議程一起給您。
ans.py: Xīngqí wǔ zǎoshang yǐqián, xiūgǎi hǎo de cǎo'àn gēn yìchéng yìqǐ gěi nín.
ans.en: By Friday morning — revised draft with the agenda attached.

them.zh: 好。這個案子做好，年底的考績我不會忘記你。
them.py: Hǎo. Zhège ànzi zuò hǎo, niándǐ de kǎojì wǒ bú huì wàngjì nǐ.
them.en: Good. Land this one, and I won't forget you at year-end review.

turns.task: Respond with hungry humility: the deal matters more than the review — but you'll take both.

ans.zh: 案子本身比考績重要——不過兩個我都要，哈哈！
ans.py: Ànzi běnshēn bǐ kǎojì zhòngyào — búguò liǎng ge wǒ dōu yào, hāhā!
ans.en: The deal matters more than the review — but I'll take both, haha!

scenarios.intro: Tonight's OPI drill: Taiwan's hidden-champion industries — why the world wears Taiwan without knowing it, whether invisibility is wise, and what your industry can steal from the textile playbook.

them.zh: 全世界的運動衣很多是台灣布料做的，但很少人知道。你怎麼看這種「看不見的冠軍」？
them.py: Quán shìjiè de yùndòngyī hěnduō shì Táiwān bùliào zuò de, dàn hěnshǎo rén zhīdào. Nǐ zěnme kàn zhè zhǒng 'kàn bú jiàn de guànjūn'?
them.en: Much of the world's sportswear uses Taiwanese fabric, yet few know it. Your take on these 'invisible champions'?

turns.task: Frame it: the B2B supply-chain-king model — immense technical value, near-zero consumer visibility; the strategy that built Taiwan's economy.

ans.zh: 這是B2B供應鏈之王的模式：技術價值極高，消費者能見度趨近於零。台灣的經濟就是這樣建立起來的。
ans.py: Zhè shì B2B gōngyìngliàn zhī wáng de móshì: jìshù jiàzhí jí gāo, xiāofèizhě néngjiàndù qūjìn yú líng. Táiwān de jīngjì jiùshì zhèyàng jiànlì qǐlái de.
ans.en: It's the B2B supply-chain-king model: immense technical value, near-zero consumer visibility. Taiwan's economy was built exactly this way.

them.zh: 「看不見」是優點還是缺點？
them.py: 'Kàn bú jiàn' shì yōudiǎn háishì quēdiǎn?
them.en: Is invisibility a strength or a weakness?

turns.task: Both: it shields you from fashion cycles and politics, but without a brand there's no pricing power when clients squeeze — the fabric maker can't appeal to consumers for help.

ans.zh: 兩者都是。看不見讓你避開流行跟政治的風險；但是沒有品牌，客戶壓價的時候你就沒有定價權——布料廠沒辦法直接找消費者求救。
ans.py: Liǎngzhě dōu shì. Kàn bú jiàn ràng nǐ bìkāi liúxíng gēn zhèngzhì de fēngxiǎn; dànshì méiyǒu pǐnpái, kèhù yājià de shíhòu nǐ jiù méiyǒu dìngjiàquán — bùliào chǎng méi bànfǎ zhíjiē zhǎo xiāofèizhě qiújiù.
ans.en: Both. Invisibility shields you from fashion and politics; but without a brand you have no pricing power when clients squeeze — the fabric maker can't appeal to consumers directly.

them.zh: 紡織業的永續轉型，你覺得是真需求還是行銷？
them.py: Fǎngzhīyè de yǒngxù zhuǎnxíng, nǐ juéde shì zhēn xūqiú háishì xíngxiāo?
them.en: The sustainability shift in textiles — real demand or marketing?

turns.task: Concede the greenwashing critique partly, then argue it's now structural: brands write recycled-content ratios into procurement contract clauses — once it's in the clauses, it's a threshold, not marketing.

ans.zh: 漂綠的批評有一部分成立。但現在國際品牌把回收比例直接寫進採購合約的條款裡——寫進條款的東西，就不再是行銷，是門檻。
ans.py: Piǎolǜ de pīpíng yǒu yíbùfèn chénglì. Dàn xiànzài guójì pǐnpái bǎ huíshōu bǐlì zhíjiē xiě jìn cǎigòu héyuē de tiáokuǎn lǐ — xiě jìn tiáokuǎn de dōngxi, jiù bú zài shì xíngxiāo, shì ménkǎn.
ans.en: The greenwashing critique partly holds. But brands now write recycled-content ratios into procurement contract clauses — once it's in the clauses, it's not marketing anymore, it's a threshold.

them.zh: 你們無人機產業可以從紡織業學到什麼？
them.py: Nǐmen wúrénjī chǎnyè kěyǐ cóng fǎngzhīyè xué dào shénme?
them.en: What can your drone industry learn from textiles?

turns.task: Three lessons: command an irreplaceable component layer, upgrade before cheap competitors arrive, and replace one-off orders with long-term contracts — exactly the framework you're drafting this week.

ans.zh: 三課：掌握別人取代不了的關鍵零組件、在便宜的競爭者出現以前先升級，還有用長期合約取代一次性訂單——這正是我這星期在寫的架構。
ans.py: Sān kè: zhǎngwò biérén qǔdài bù liǎo de guānjiàn língzǔjiàn, zài piányí de jìngzhēngzhě chūxiàn yǐqián xiān shēngjí, háiyǒu yòng chángqí héyuē qǔdài yícìxìng dìngdān — zhè zhèng shì wǒ zhè xīngqí zài xiě de jiàgòu.
ans.en: Three lessons: command an irreplaceable component layer, upgrade before cheap competitors arrive, and replace one-off orders with long-term contracts — exactly the framework I'm drafting this week.

turns.keys: 取代不了升級長期合約

them.zh: 從洗衣服聊到產業戰略，厲害！謝謝分享！
them.py: Cóng xǐ yīfú liáo dào chǎnyè zhànlüè, lìhài! Xièxie fēnxiǎng!
them.en: From laundry to industrial strategy — impressive! Thanks for sharing!

turns.task: Close with the day's moral: laundry or supply chains — separate what shouldn't mix, and put valuable things in professional hands.

ans.zh: 今天的心得：不管是洗衣服還是供應鏈——該分開的要分開，值錢的東西要交給專業。
ans.py: Jīntiān de xīndé: bùguǎn shì xǐ yīfú háishì gōngyìngliàn — gāi fēnkāi de yào fēnkāi, zhíqián de dōngxi yào jiāo gěi zhuānyè.
ans.en: Today's moral: laundry or supply chains — separate what shouldn't mix, and put the valuable things in professional hands.

x: 紅色在台灣代表好運。
Hóngsè zài Táiwān dàibiǎo hǎoyùn.
Red stands for good luck in Taiwan.
vocab.n: Red envelopes, wedding invitations, lanterns — the culture's power color. Never write names in red ink.

x: 我要那件藍色的外套。
Wǒ yào nà jiàn lánsè de wàitào.
I'll take that blue jacket.
vocab.n: 深藍 dark blue, 淺藍 light blue — 深/淺 shade any color.

x: 白色的衣服很容易髒。
Báisè de yīfú hěn róngyì zāng.
White clothes get dirty so easily.
vocab.n: Culture note: white is the traditional funeral color — don't gift white flowers casually.

x: 黑色的最百搭。
Hēisè de zuì bǎidā.
Black goes with everything.
vocab.n: 百搭 = matches everything. 黑色星期五 = Black Friday, imported sales madness included.

x: 洗衣機還要二十分鐘。
Xǐyījī hái yào èrshí fēnzhōng.
The washer needs twenty more minutes.
vocab.n: The -機 machine family: 洗衣機, 飲水機 (water dispenser), 販賣機 (vending machine).

x: 這件襯衫髒了，要洗了。
Zhè jiàn chènshān zāng le, yào xǐ le.
This shirt's dirty — time to wash it.
vocab.n: 髒話 = profanity; 弄髒 = to get something dirty.

vocab.e: to sun-dry, hang out (laundry); to sunbathe
x: 衣服拿去陽台曬。
Yīfú ná qù yángtái shài.
Take the laundry to the balcony to dry.
vocab.n: 曬太陽 sunbathe, 曬衣服 hang laundry — the same 曬 as the 曬娃 photo-flexing slang.

x: 深色跟淺色要分開洗。
Shēnsè gēn qiǎnsè yào fēnkāi xǐ.
Wash darks and lights separately.
vocab.n: Also for bills (分開算 split the check) and, gently, for couples (他們分開了).

x: 西裝我都送洗，不自己洗。
Xīzhuāng wǒ dōu sòngxǐ, bù zìjǐ xǐ.
Suits I always send out — never wash them myself.
vocab.n: 送 + service verb = outsource it: 送洗 send to clean, 送修 send for repair.

x: 毛衣用熱水洗會縮水。
Máoyī yòng rè shuǐ xǐ huì suōshuǐ.
Sweaters shrink in hot water.
vocab.n: Metaphor gold: 薪水縮水 shrinking paycheck, 預算縮水 shrinking budget — news loves it.

x: 這件紅色的洗幾次就褪色了。
Zhè jiàn hóngsè de xǐ jǐ cì jiù tùnsè le.
This red one faded after a few washes.
vocab.n: Also figurative: 記憶褪色 memories fade. Taiwan also reads it tuìsè — both are heard.

x: 這件不要烘乾，會縮水。
Zhè jiàn búyào hōnggān, huì suōshuǐ.
Don't machine-dry this one — it'll shrink.
vocab.n: 烘乾機 = dryer — rarer in Taiwan homes than you'd think: the balcony is the national dryer.

x: 合作架構的草案我寫好了。
Hézuò jiàgòu de cǎo'àn wǒ xiě hǎo le.
I've written the cooperation-framework draft.
vocab.n: 草 = rough: 草稿 rough draft, 草案 draft bill/proposal — the word in every legislature headline.

x: 這個提案下週給客戶看。
Zhège tí'àn xià zhōu gěi kèhù kàn.
This proposal goes to the client next week.
vocab.n: 提 raise + 案 case. In meetings: 我有一個提案 — I'd like to propose something.

x: 簽約當天的議程確認了嗎？
Qiānyuē dàngtiān de yìchéng quèrèn le ma?
Is the signing-day agenda confirmed?
vocab.n: 議 discuss + 程 schedule. 排上議程 = to get onto the agenda — literal and political.

x: 維修合約是提案的第二部分。
Wéixiū héyuē shì tí'àn de dì èr bùfèn.
The maintenance contract is part two of the proposal.
vocab.n: 維 maintain + 修 repair: 定期維修 scheduled maintenance, 維修站 service depot. The after-sales promise, as a noun.

x: 台灣的紡織產業很早就轉型了。
Táiwān de fǎngzhī chǎnyè hěn zǎo jiù zhuǎnxíng le.
Taiwan's textile industry transformed early.
vocab.n: 紡織業 = the textile industry — the quiet giant behind global sportswear.

x: 這種布料防水又透氣。
Zhè zhǒng bùliào fángshuǐ yòu tòuqì.
This fabric is waterproof yet breathable.
vocab.n: 料 = material: 布料 fabric, 材料 materials, 原料 raw materials — the manufacturing word family.

x: 機能布料是台灣的強項。
Jīnéng bùliào shì Táiwān de qiángxiàng.
Functional fabrics are Taiwan's strong suit.
vocab.n: Taiwan/Japan usage: 機能衣 performance wear, 機能飲料 energy drinks. The mainland says 功能 instead.

x: 台灣在全球供應鏈占有關鍵地位。
Táiwān zài quánqiú gōngyìngliàn zhànyǒu guānjiàn dìwèi.
Taiwan holds a key position in global supply chains.
vocab.n: THE geopolitics word of the decade: 供應鏈安全 supply-chain security, 斷鏈 disruption. DLPT will serve it constantly.

x: 自己洗西裝太搞剛了，送洗啦！
Zìjǐ xǐ xīzhuāng tài gau-kang le, sòngxǐ la!
Washing a suit yourself is way too much hassle — send it out!
slang.n: Hokkien 厚工 'thick work': anything effortful beyond reason. Compliment for craftsmanship, complaint for chores.

x: 大家都收到通知，只有我沒有，當我塑膠喔？
Dàjiā dōu shōudào tōngzhī, zhǐyǒu wǒ méiyǒu, dàng wǒ sùjiāo o?
Everyone got the notice except me — am I plastic to you?
slang.n: Taiwan internet: 當我塑膠？ = treating me like I don't exist? From plastic's fake-and-worthless image.

x: 這件花襯衫很有阿嬤的味道。
Zhè jiàn huā chènshān hěn yǒu a-má de wèidào.
This floral shirt has serious grandma energy.
slang.n: Hokkien. 阿公 a-kong = grandpa. 阿嬤的花布 (grandma's floral fabric) is a beloved retro-Taiwan aesthetic.

x: 衣櫃太滿了，週末來斷捨離一下。
Yīguì tài mǎn le, zhōumò lái duànshělí yíxià.
Closet's overflowing — decluttering session this weekend.
slang.n: Japanese-coined (danshari), adopted across the Chinese internet. The KonMari-adjacent life philosophy, now a verb.

x: 那台烘乾機買來就在陽台吃灰。
Nà tái hōnggānjī mǎi lái jiù zài yángtái chīhuī.
That dryer has been eating dust on the balcony since day one.
slang.n: Mainland internet: unused purchases 'eat dust.' The fate of every impulse buy, right after the 剁手 and the 吃土.
